resolution: Built SKYBOX_PLAYBOOK seam 1 (the proving slice) end-to-end: the void-math, the procedural shell, and the first distortion consumer (sky-drift), live in the editor play renderer. Added cart/hmsc-int/game/void/{distance,distortion,shell}.ts (escape_depth scalar derived from the authored map bounds, voidDistortion() as ONE continuous smoothstep fan-out to 9 weights, and a hash-deterministic stride-9 shell that skips the authored core), render3d/VoidShell.tsx (one Scene3D.Instances streamed on the player chunk cell) and render3d/skyDrift.ts (warps HmscSky by the skyDrift weight), all wired in render3d/GameWorld3D.tsx. Scope was design-gate-confirmed with the user (full seam 1 incl. the procedural shell, not just the math). Invisible in normal authored play (count 0, identity sky inside the core) so purely additive; escape_depth reads REAL distance for now (treadmill = seam 2). Verified: game/void/void.test.ts 9/9 pass + full rjit ship hmsc-int green (exit 0). Live visual (drive past the edge to see the city thin) is a rjit dev check — headless can't drive the player and the heavy editor OOMs the boot watchdog regardless. Docs updated per the maintenance contract (SKYBOX_PLAYBOOK.md status + seam-1 marked built; _index/records/skybox_void.ts three interfaces flipped candidate→live).
